cues: A signal never arrives exactly as it was sent.
Attenuation: it weakens with distance, so repeaters regenerate it.
Distortion: its shape changes, because different frequencies travel at different speeds.
And noise: unwanted energy added on the way, from heat in the wires, from neighbouring wires, which is crosstalk, or from sudden spikes like lightning.
